answer: Proof of Stake requires agents to lock collateral, ensuring identity uniqueness via financial cost. Like a walnut shell protecting a kernel, high entry requirements force attackers to deplete capital, slowing them like a crawling glacier. For decentralized networks to function, validator state must remain as precise as quartz crystal oscillators. An attacker faces prohibitive hardware and stake costs, rendering mass identity forgery economically irrational versus the value of honest participation.
